quest.title: Grateful to the Gods
quest.description: Jilliana is looking for someone to clean the Statues of The Seven, since she hasn't had time lately...

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder what state the Statues of The Seven must be in by now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Statues of The Seven? What's happened to them?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Let me explain... In the past, I would go and pray to a Statue of The Seven every week, and while I was there I would wipe the dust off.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I have the archons to thank for all the blessings in my life — cleaning their statues was my way of giving something back.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: But since having Lily, I rarely have the chance to go out.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: The statues must be filthy with no one cleaning them in so long.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I know this must seem like I'm trying to avoid taking responsibility, but... Do you think you could go and wipe the dust off of the Statues of The Seven for me?

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Thank you ever so much! May the Anemo Archon protect you.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: One more thing. The Statues of The Seven are imbued with the power of the archons.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: The dust they collect cannot be simply wiped off in the usual manner.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: But you have elemental abilities. It should be easy for you.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Unlike me — it's a whole day's work for me to clean a single statue.

choices.text: Surely the wind would just blow it off?

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Barbatos and the winds he commands have far too many other things to attend to day-to-day.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: In any case, we mustn't rely on the archons to provide for everything while we laze around.

response.speaker: Jilliana
response.text: Let us work together to lighten our Lord Barbatos' load just a little.

talks.objective: Clean the Statue of The Seven at Starfell Lake

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Have you finished cleaning the Statues of The Seven?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I see. Well, there's no rush — take your time.

talks.objective: Clean the Statue of The Seven at Windrise

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Have you finished cleaning the Statues of The Seven?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Bless you, my dear! May Barbatos protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Take these, they are my gift to you. I may call on your assistance again in future.
